title: Decision
description: A person's or Team Lead's answer to a card, kept so a repeat question is answered from it (PRD 8.3, 13.1, 15.1; FR-AGT-07, FR-MEM-08). Stored at orgs/{org}/decisions/{decision}, append-only. tilo-api writes it when the answer is recorded; the harness reads it and cites id as question.answered data.decision_id. Only questions are answered from a decision: a gate is opened only by approval.resolved, which never cites one. Rules the schema cannot express are DC-01 to DC-04 in decision.rules.md.

domain.description: Team Lead domain the question was routed by (question.routed data.domain); null for the owner fallback. A Team Lead's decision always names their domain.

option_id.description: The card option chosen; null for a typed answer.

expires_at.description: After this time the decision answers nothing; null means it does not expire.

answerer.description: The authz shape (BQ-01) narrowed to who answers a question: the owner of the source world (ref is their user id; an Approver's answer makes no Decision, DC-01) or a Team Lead (ref is the Team Lead id and user the person who held it and answered, DC-02). A policy never answers a question and a model never does. DC-04 checks the answerer again in the world of each repeat question, and a Team Lead's Decision answers only while the same person holds that Team Lead id.

source.description: The card whose answer this records (PRD 15.1: a card records a decision).

scope.description: Where the decision may answer a repeat question: all worlds of the org the answerer may answer in (worlds the person owns, or worlds of the owner who assigned the Team Lead; DC-01, DC-02) or the listed ones among them, and in them all districts or the listed district ids (BQ-60).
